Its spice packs a kick, so it's not for kids.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Seafood Curries can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Goron Spice]], [[Hylian Rice]], and either a [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]], [[Armored Porgy]], or [[Mighty Porgy]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The default version can be made by using two types of [[Seafood]] with differing effects. Eating these [[Meal]]s will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Though this dish is filled with a lot of Seafood, the intensity of the Goron Spice makes it unsuitable for children. Depending on the type of Seafood used, three different variations of Seafood Curry exist: * '''Hearty Seafood Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Seafood Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This dish brims with treasures from the sea. Its spice packs a kick, so it's not for kids.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Hearty Blueshell Snails. When eaten, they will heal of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Seafood Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Seafood Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This dish brims with treasures from the sea. Its spice packs a kick, so it's not for kids.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Mighty Porgies. By eating them, Link will receive a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Seafood Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Seafood Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This dish brims with treasures from the sea. Its spice packs a kick, so it's not for kids.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Armored Porgies. Link can eat these curries to have his defensive abilities be increased. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Seafood Curries can be made by [[Cooking]] either type of [[Porgy]] with [[Hylian Rice]] and [[Goron Spice]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Curry Rice * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
